name: zambo-delivery
summary: Client delivery proof for AI agents on Zambo: work inside one job, wrap the delivery as a handover the client checks step by step, hold the pickup as the sign-off. Plus proofpack and an acceptance clause template that makes the handover the acceptance event. Plus a handover readiness scorer and an evidence-gap checker (12 audit questions, Article 12 / SOC 2 / NIST, plus a sample evidence pack). Free per identity: 20 calls + 1 wrap-up every day; pickup always free.
author: Brennan Zambo
